from donations import load_donations, ROWS
from finder import donations_for

KEY = ROWS[0][0]
COUNT = sum(1 for k, _ in ROWS if k == KEY)


def test_upper_case_with_spaces():
    assert len(donations_for(list(load_donations()), " " + KEY.upper() + " ")) == COUNT


def test_exact():
    assert len(donations_for(list(load_donations()), KEY)) == COUNT
